title: Set up Business Central data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric

facts.text: Production-ready preview planned to become available in October 2026. Delivery timing and functionality might change. Subject to supplemental terms of use.
Business Central 2026 release wave 2, version 29.0 or later required.
Microsoft Fabric Mirroring extension must be installed from Microsoft Marketplace.
Data encryption must be enabled. Business Central stores the app client secret in encrypted isolated storage.
User must have MS Fabric Mirroring - Admin permission set or equivalent permissions to set up mirroring.
Dedicated app registration in Microsoft Entra ID required. Must provide application client ID, client secret, and service-principal object ID during setup.
Access to active Microsoft Fabric capacity required. User must be Member or Admin of Fabric workspace to add mirroring service principal.
Fabric workspace must be in same Microsoft Entra tenant as Business Central environment.
